purpose: Choose exactly one mechanism-independent deterministic Alpha158 price-volume confirmation factor for Campaign295 without reading Campaign295 candidate values, comparator values, daily prices or forward returns.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_price_volume_directional_confirmation_20d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The fixed Alpha158 definitions already expose a 20-session signed price-change balance (SUMD20) and the 20-session correlation of daily price ratios with log volume ratios (CORD20). Multiplying SUMD20 by the bounded confirmation weight (1+CORD20)/2 preserves price direction while continuously strengthening it when price and volume changes co-move. This is a raw within-stock price-volume interaction, not another peer-rank state, persistence, extremity or horizon-geometry statistic.

parameters.valid_input_interval: both inputs must be finite and lie in [-1,1] within 1e-6 numerical tolerance

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_raw_sumd20
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: SUMD20 alone is an existing raw Alpha158 coordinate rather than a new interaction mechanism and would ignore the selected volume-confirmation hypothesis.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_raw_cord20
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: CORD20 alone measures unsigned price-volume coupling and does not preserve an investable price direction; it is also an existing raw Alpha158 coordinate.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_price_volume_confirmation_product_20d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The unshifted product SUMD20*CORD20 would score a falling price trend with negative price-volume correlation as positive and therefore would not preserve the frozen directional interpretation.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_price_volume_confirmation_horizon_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Trying 5, 10, 20, 30 or 60 sessions, averaging them, or selecting the best horizon would reopen the horizon search prohibited by the Campaign294 handoff. One conventional 20-session trading-month horizon is frozen before values.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_price_volume_confirmation_weight_or_transform_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Exponentiating, thresholding, clipping, signing or fitting CORD20, or changing the price/volume weight, would create an avoidable transform search. The unique affine map from [-1,1] to [0,1] is frozen.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign286-289 already consumed those frozen supervised or randomized model mechanisms. Campaign295 is a single deterministic no-fit factor.

selected_formula.name: alpha158_price_volume_directional_confirmation_20d
selected_formula.formula: For each quality-listing row with frozen Alpha158 model support, require finite SUMD20 and CORD20, each inside [-1,1] within 1e-6. Set w=(1+CORD20)/2 and score=SUMD20*w. Do not fill, clip, winsorize, rank, sign, threshold, lag, fit, invert, subset, average across horizons or combine this score.
selected_formula.economic_hypothesis: A positive 20-session price-change imbalance is more credible when daily price ratios and log volume ratios move together, while an unconfirmed directional imbalance should be attenuated. The resulting volume-confirmed price pressure may persist from the next accepted open through the third accepted close.
